description: Use after get_voice_conversion says the job is complete and the user wants the cleaned or standard output. Downloads are free; the conversion was counted once when it started. If the exact file was downloaded before, ask before retrying and then set confirmRepeat true.

confirmRepeat.description: Only true after the user explicitly confirms downloading the same artifact again.

kind.description: cleaned (recommended) or normal for a vocal conversion; for a whole-song cover, any kind listed in files, for example cover, instrumental or vocal_combined.

name: download_voice_conversion_output
title: Download a completed voice conversion
